purpose: Fail closed before production assets are promoted from warehouse preparation into Unreal import/runtime integration.

texture_contract.foliage_alpha: Masked-overdraw review required before density increase

runtime_contract.density_rule: No foliage/crowd/detail density escalation before target-device profiling

promotion_rules.ready_for_import: All provenance, format and technical QC checks relevant to the asset class must pass.
promotion_rules.imported: UE4 import succeeded; this still does not imply runtime integration.
promotion_rules.integrated: Asset is bound into the intended world/system with stable IDs and ownership.
promotion_rules.accepted: Requires the chapter/system machine evidence plus the human visual/pacing/performance gates defined by ProjectGovernor.

evidence_boundary: Policy definition only. It does not assert that any individual asset passed QC.
